days.shot: Your first look at the fair

rows.title: Land
rows.desc: MIA or FLL. MIA is about 20 minutes from the house and FLL about 40–50. We’ll share Ubers from each airport.

rows.title: Bags down, quick lunch
rows.desc: I’ll ask the host about dropping bags early. Then a quick lunch nearby.

rows.title: Art Basel Miami Beach
rows.desc: Miami Beach Convention Center, open until 6. Day ticket $92. Ride over, or try the free water taxi.

rows.title: Check in, shower, get ready
rows.desc: Time to get ready.

rows.title: Welcome dinner, Casa Neos
rows.desc: On the Miami River. About $100–150 each. Book.

rows.title: Out
rows.desc: Easiest option: unKommon Art Week at Little River Studios, a few blocks from the house. Tickets on DICE.

rows.title: Brunch, Coconut Grove Farmers Market
rows.desc: 3300 Grand Ave. Saturdays only.

rows.title: Superblue: James Turrell’s Blue Sea Sky
rows.desc: 1101 NW 23rd St. $42 on weekends. Book a time.

rows.title: Design District, ICA Miami, Edgewater
rows.desc: ICA is free. Galleries, shops and a walk by the water.

rows.title: Rest
rows.desc: Back to the house for a break.

rows.title: The boat
rows.desc: About $120 USD each, fuel included. We leave before sunset and come back after dark. Book.

rows.title: Dinner at Mangrove
rows.desc: Jamaican food and a cocktail bar downtown, 103 NW 1st Ave, close to where the boat comes in. Around $30 each before drinks. A DJ plays later and the bar is open until 3, so we can stay. Book.

rows.title: Everyday People
rows.desc: The Art Week party. The 2026 date isn’t out yet. Last year it was on Saturday and cost $35. If it’s not on Saturday this year, we stay at Mangrove.

rows.title: Circoloco, if you want it
rows.desc: Factory Town, Hialeah. Doors at 10, from $211.

rows.title: VOUS Church
rows.desc: Design District, 77 NE 40th St. Services at 10 and 12.

rows.title: Matcha at Bigface
rows.desc: 40 NE 40th St, across the street.

rows.title: Beach club: Nikki Beach or Joia Beach
rows.desc: Four hours in the sun. About $100–150 each. Flying home today? Pack your bags in the morning and go to the airport from here. Book.

rows.title: Wynwood Walls
rows.desc: Straight from the beach club, around golden hour. About $12–15, and an hour is plenty.

rows.title: Home to change
rows.desc: If you’re staying Monday.

rows.title: Low-key dinner
rows.desc: Somewhere casual near the house, or takeout at the house. Everyone pays for their own.

days.shot: The last view before you fly

rows.title: Coffee, then pack
rows.desc: Check out by 11, time to confirm with the host. Bags come with us.

rows.title: Work from Miami
rows.desc: A coworking space in Wynwood or a café with good Wi-Fi. We’ll pick one closer to the date.

rows.title: Or take the day
rows.desc: A last swim, anything we missed, or a long lunch.

rows.title: Airport
rows.desc: For flights around 9. Leave extra time for FLL.
